title: Talking about past experiences / Hadashada dhibaatooyin ee ugu horreysay
bridge: Farangaashiis, inoo hadalno dhibaatooyin ee ugu horreysay waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'pretérito perfecto compuesto' ('he visitado') ama 'pretérito indefinido' ('visité'), haddii ay wakhtigu la xiriira hadda ama maya. Ingiriishi, dhibaatooyin ee nolosha waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'present perfect' ('have visited'), oo uma eg yaran u leh farangaashiis. Waxa ugu muhiimadaa in Ingiriishi waxay isticmaalayaan 'have + participio' waxaad samayn lahaa wakhti aan xad la'aan, markaas farangaashiis waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'pretérito indefinido' waxaad samayn lahaa wakhti xad la'aan. Fiir: Ingiriishi ma isticmali karo 'present perfect' ilaa jeer la xiriira wakhti ugu horreysay xad la'aan sida 'yesterday' ama 'last year'.
rule: Inoo hadalno dhibaatooyin ee ugu horreysay Ingiriishi, waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'present perfect' qorista: have/has + participio ugu horreysay. Waxay isticmaalayaan: 1) dhibaatooyin ee nolosha aan wakhti xad la'aan (I have visited Paris), 2) waxaad samayn lahaa ugu horreysay oo leh xiriir hadda (She has lost her keys), 3) la adverbios sida 'ever', 'never', 'already', 'yet', 'just', 'before'. Qorista cadaadiska waxay ku dhigtaa 'have not' (haven't) ama 'has not' (hasn't). Su'aasha waxay beddeltama 'auxiliar' (Have you ever...?). Inoo su'aalo dhibaatooyin, waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'Have you ever + participio?' oo waxaynu jawaabnaa 'Yes, I have' ama 'No, I never have'. 'Present perfect' ma isticmali karo ilaa jeer la xiriira wakhti ugu horreysay xad la'aan (yesterday, last week, in 2010). Halkaas, waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'past simple' (visited, went). A2, waa muhiim inaad qabto participios ee faraybixiyeya (go-gone, eat-eaten, see-seen, have-had).

concept_examples.text: I have visited Mexico.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan boqday Mexico.

concept_examples.text: She has never eaten sushi.
concept_examples.translation: Iyada uma uguun cuntay sushi.

concept_examples.text: Have you ever seen that movie?
concept_examples.translation: Sidee baad fiiray filmigan?

concept_examples.text: We have already finished our homework.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaynu dhammaynay xogta.

common_error.explanation: Khalaadkan waxay noqotaa maxaa yeelay farangaashiis waxaad dhigeen 'He visitado París ayer' qaybiyada, laakiin Ingiriishi 'present perfect' uma xiriiri karo ilaa jeer la xiriira wakhti ugu horreysay xad la'aan sida 'yesterday'. Wakhti xad la'aan ugu horreysay, waxaad isticmaalayaa 'past simple' (visited). Haddii aan wakhti xad la'aan, waxaad isticmaalayaa 'present perfect' (have visited). Xusuuso: 'present perfect' + wakhti xad la'aan = khalad.

examples.original: Have you ever been to London?
examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'ever' su'aashada inoo su'aalo dhibaatooyin ee nolosha.

examples.original: I have never tried Thai food.
examples.note: 'Never' waxay ku dhigtaa 'have' iyo participio, oo waxay tusaale suura 'nolosha'.

examples.original: She has never flown in a plane.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ˈnɛvər floʊn ɪn ə pleɪn/
examples.note: Xusuuso in 'flown' waa participio 'fly', fiil aan xaqan leh.
'Already' waxay isticmaalayaan tashadiis oo waxay tusaale suura 'hadda' (si degdeg ah).

examples.original: Have you bought the tickets yet?
examples.note: 'Yet' waxay isticmaalayaan su'aashada iyo cadaadiska, dhammaadka jirka, oo waxay tusaale suura 'haddana'.

examples.original: We haven't finished our project yet.
examples.note: Cadaadiska, 'yet' waxay ku dhigtaa dhammaadka oo waxay tusaale suura in waxba uma baxay ilaa hadda.

examples.translation: Waxaan joogay Peru (wakhti aan xad la'aan ah nolosha).
examples.note: 'Present perfect' waxay isticmaalayaan aan wakhti xad la'aan, dhibaatooyin.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɛnt tə pəˈruː ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd nɪnˈtiːn/
examples.note: 'Past simple' waxay isticmaalayaan ilaa jeer la xiriira wakhti ugu horreysay xad la'aan, sida 'in 2019'.

examples.original: She has lived in Madrid for two years.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi hæz lɪvd ɪn məˈdrɪd fɔːr tuː jɪrz/
examples.translation: Iyada waxay noolaaday Madrid laba sano.
examples.note: 'Present perfect' waxay isticmaalayaan 'for' + wakhti inay hadashaan waxaad samayn lahaa oo hadda ku socda.
Past simple, fiilka 'see' waxay noqotaa 'saw', oo waxay isticmaalayaan wakhti xad la'aan.

title: Making Plans and Arrangements / Qorsheynta iyo xaaladaha
bridge: Faransiiska ayaa aan isticmaalno hadalka aad u dambeeyey (ir a + infinitivo) si aan u hadalno qorsheynta. Ingiriishi, qorsheynta iyo xaaladaha waxaa laga isticmaalaa 'had iyo jeer' (I'm meeting) xaaladaha xad gudbeen, iyo 'be going to' (I'm going to visit) qorsheynta. Fiirso: Ingiriishi ma isticmaalin present simple oo leh mustaqbalka shakhsi, haddii ay isku leh Faransiiska (e.g. 'Te llamo mañana' → 'I'll call you tomorrow', no 'I call you'). Waxaana 'will' lagu isticmaalaa qaybta si toos ah, qorsheynta la sameeyey.
rule:
Si aad u qorshayo qorsheynta iyo xaaladaha Ingiriishi A2, isticmaalaa xogtaan:

1. **Present continuous** (am/is/are + -ing): qorsheynta iyo xaaladaha la soo dhaafay, waqtiga iyo meeshka. E.g. 'I'm seeing the doctor at 3.' (He hecho la cita).

2. **Be going to** (am/is/are going to + infinitivo): qorsheynta ama qorsheynta oo aan u xusuusanin xogta xad gudbeen. E.g. 'We're going to visit our grandparents.' (Tenemos la intención).

3. **Will** (will + verbo base): qaybta la qaaday markii la hadlayo, soo bandhigga ama ballanka. E.g. 'I'll help you with that.' (Decisión espontánea).

4. **Would like to** (would like to + infinitivo): soo bandhigga ama qorsheynta oo si rasmi ah ama adag. E.g. 'Would you like to come to my party?'

Xusuuso in Ingiriishi ma isticmaalin present simple oo leh mustaqbalka shakhsi (isku leh Faransiiska qayb ka mid ah). Isticmaala 'be going to' ama 'present continuous' qorsheynta.

Ingiriishi, present simple ma ay sheegin mustaqbalka shakhsi; qorsheynta xad gudbeen waxaa lagu isticmaalaa present continuous (I'm meeting) ama 'be going to' (I'm going to meet).

levels.translation: Ku soo bax iyo u jawaabo xusuusada

title: Giving advice and recommendations / Fiiri iyo tashriif
bridge: Faransiiska, si aad u fiirisa waxaan isticmaalna subjunctive (te recomiendo que vayas, deberías ir). Ingiriishi, subjunctive ma isticmaalin 'recommend' ama 'suggest' ka dib; waxaan isticmaalna shakhliga aasaasiga ah ee fiilka ama obect + infinitive: 'I recommend you go', 'I suggest you try'. Waxaana isticmaalna 'should' (deberías) oo jecel yahay 'must'. Khalad gaar ahaan waa in la soo jiido subjunctive faransiiska: 'I recommend that you go' waa sax, laakiin 'I recommend you to go' waa khalad joogaan maxaa yeelay Ingiriishi 'recommend' ma la raacdo infinitive 'to' markii ay jirto obect.
rule:
Si aad u fiirisid iyo tashriifad Ingiriishi miga A2, isticmaalaa xaaladdan kuwaas:
1. **Should / Shouldn't + fiil aasaasig**: fiiri aad u jecel. Mis: 'You should eat more vegetables.' 'You shouldn't stay up late.' (shakhliga xumanta). Ma la qayb galin (he should, no he shoulds).
2. **You could + fiil aasaasig**: tashriifad jecel yahay ama doorashad. Mis: 'You could try yoga.'
3. **I recommend / I suggest + that + isku + fiil aasaasig** (ilaa 'to' iyo subjunctive ilaa dhamaad). Mis: 'I recommend that you see a doctor.' Waxaad isticmaalay kartaa gerund: 'I recommend seeing a doctor.' ama 'I suggest trying this.'
4. **How about + gerund (-ing)?**: tashriifad adag. Mis: 'How about going for a walk?'
5. **Why don't you + fiil aasaasig?**: tashriifad oo su'aalo ah. Mis: 'Why don't you take a break?'
Tus: ha isticmaalin 'must' fiiriyeya, waa adag; 'must' waa wajibaad. Fiiriyeya jecel yahay, isticmaala 'could' ama 'might'. Xusuuso in 'recommend' iyo 'suggest' ka dib, 'to' ma isticmaalin obect ka dib: 'I recommend you to go' waa khalad.

concept_examples.text: You should drink more water.
concept_examples.translation: Waa inaad ku darato biyo.

concept_examples.text: I recommend that you talk to the teacher.

concept_examples.text: How about studying with us?

common_error.wrong: I recommend you to go to the doctor.
common_error.correct: I recommend that you go to the doctor.
common_error.correct_alt: I recommend going to the doctor.
common_error.explanation: Faransiiska waxay nuugutaa 'te recomiendo que vayas' ama 'te recomiendo ir', laakiin Ingiriishi, 'recommend' ka dib ma isticmaalin infinitive 'to' obect ka dib. Xaaladda saxaaxa ah waa 'recommend + that + isku + fiil aasaasig' ama 'recommend + gerund'. Khaladkan wuxuu u dhacaa maxaa yeelay ardayada ay u tarjuman yihiin 'te recomiendo a ti ir' (oo ku dhumucaa 'recommend you to go'). Si aad u ilaalin khaladkan, xusuuso: 'recommend' wuxuu la xiriirtaa 'that' ama '-ing', mar dhowr 'to'.

examples.note: Isticmaala 'should' + fiil aasaasig. Faransiiska, 'deberías' + infinitive.

examples.translation: Isaga ma aahaan inuu cunto sugar badan.
examples.note: Shakhliga xumanta waa 'shouldn't' + fiil aasaasig. Ma la qayb galin isku saddexaad.

examples.note: 'Should' ma beddelin isku: I should, you should, we should.

examples.original: How about going to the park?
examples.translation: Sidee baa loo helaya inaan u tagno birta?
examples.note: 'How about' ka dib waxaa isticmaalaya gerund (-ing).

examples.translation: Sidee baa loo helaya inaan u baxno dhinac?

title: Expressing opinions / Araweeya arrimaha (Waxaan u maleynayaa, Waxaan u maleynayaa)
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, 'waxaan u maleynayaa' iyo 'waxaan u maleynayaa' ayaa la isticmaalo kala duwan, laakiin Ingiriisi, 'I think' waa uumadii ugu yaraan oo la isticmaalo arrimaha iyo dembiyada, 'I believe' waxay u cadhaysan tahay oo keliya arrimaha shakhsiya ah. Khalad aan la adeego waxaa ah in 'Yo pienso que' la tusaaleeyo 'I think that', laakiin Ingiriisi 'that' waa optional oo badan la ayay. Haddana, Ingiriisi waxaa lagu qoro su'aal + fiil + complement, ma jira preposition extra oo 'in' ama 'of'. Fiirso marnaba qoraalka iyo ha ku dar 'that' si waajibi ah.
rule:
Si aad u sheegto arrimaha Ingiriisi A2, waxaan isticmaamo sawirada aan ka socda:
- 'Waxaan u maleynayaa (in) + jawaab' - arrimaha iyo dembiyada uumadii.
- 'Waxaan u maleynayaa (in) + jawaab' - rumaynta ama arrimaha shakhsiya.
- 'In my opinion, + jawaab' - waxay u cadhaysan tahay, laakiin waxay nuqday bishan.
Kalsoonada kale oo fiican leh: 'Waxaan u maleynayaa' (aan u maleynayo) iyo 'Waxaan u maleynayaa' (aan u maleynayo), labaduba maanta.
Xusuuso: 'that' waa optional oo badan la ayay. Sawirada waxay noqon doontaa: su'aal + fiil + complement. Ha isticmaalo 'of' ama 'on' 'think/believe' ka dib. Ma ha qorin 'Waxaan u maleynayaa in', laakiin 'Waxaan u maleynayaa in' ama 'Waxaan u maleynayaa'. Tusaale: 'Waxaan u maleynayaa (in) waa fikrad wanaagsan', 'Waxaan u maleynayaa (in) isku halleeya'. Su'aasha maanta, waxaad ku dar kartaa 'do you think?' ugu dambeyntii: 'Waa fikrad wanaagsan, do you think?'

concept_examples.text: I think it's going to rain.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in ay soo jeedin doontaa.

concept_examples.text: I believe you are right.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in aad saxan tahay.

concept_examples.text: In my opinion, this movie is great.
concept_examples.translation: Arkayda, wuxuu u adag yahay in filmigan wanaagsan yahay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ðɪs ˈmuːvi ɪz ɡreɪt/

concept_examples.text: I guess we can try again.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan mar kale u jarribno.

common_error.wrong: I think in that it is good.
common_error.correct: I think that it is good.
common_error.explanation: Khaladku wuxuu ka yimid tusaale cusub oo 'pienso en que' oo 'en' preposition ah ayuu u rogrogmay. Ingiriisi, fiilka 'think' iyo 'believe' ma ay u baahnayeen preposition ilaa complement. Ka saar 'in' ama 'on'. Haddana, 'that' waa optional, marka 'Waxaan u maleynayaa in wanaagsan yahay' waa mid abuur ah oo badan la ayay.

Halkan 'believe in' waxay tusaalahay inaad rumaysan tahay in wax, laakiin markaad arrimaha sheegto waxaad isticmaashaa 'believe that'.

examples.original: I believe that he is honest.
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in isaga waa mid saxan.

title: Agreeing and Disagreeing / Bilowga iyo aan bilowayn
bridge: Faransiiska, inaan bilowga waxaynu leedahay 'estoy de acuerdo' oo aan bilowayn 'no estoy de acuerdo', laakiin Ingiriishi waxaa la isticmaalaa cadaabado badan oo toos ah oo 'I agree' iyo 'I disagree'. Waxaa adag loo isticmaalaa 'so do I' iyo 'neither do I' in la soo baxshado bilowga xaalad ama diida, waxa aan lahayn mid la mid ah faransiiska oo ay u eg yahay khalad. Xusuuso in 'agree' waa fiil, aan ahayn midab, sidaas daraaddeed ha odhan 'I am agree', laakiin 'I agree'.
rule: Inaan bilowga Ingiriishi waxaynu leedahay 'I agree' (waan bilow), ama 'I think so' (waa aan u maleynayaa). Inaan bilowayn, waxaynu leedahay 'I disagree' (ma bilow), ama 'I don't think so' (ma aan u maleynayn). In la bilowga xaalad oo xaqiiqsanaanta ah, waxaynu leedahay 'So do I' (anigu qud) ama 'Me too' (anigu qud). In la bilowga diida, waxaynu leedahay 'Neither do I' (anigu qud) ama 'Me neither' (anigu qud). Waxaynu isticmaali karnaa 'Exactly' (xaqiiq) ama 'That's right' (waa xaqiiq) inaanu u cadhno bilowga, iyo 'I'm not sure' (ma adag yaanay) inaanu u soo baxshano bilowga jaban. Xusuuso in 'agree' waa fiil caad: I agree, adiga oo baa leh, isaga/iyada oo baa leh. In la weydiiyo arraajka, waxaynu leedahay 'Do you agree?' (ma bilow?).

concept_examples.text: I agree with you.
concept_examples.translation: Waan bilow kuugaaga.

concept_examples.text: I disagree with that idea.
concept_examples.translation: Ma bilow fiirkaas.

concept_examples.text: So do I.
concept_examples.translation: Anigu qud.

concept_examples.text: Neither do I.
concept_examples.translation: Anigu qud.

common_error.explanation: Khalaadkuu u dhacaa maxaa yeelay faransiiska 'estar de acuerdo' waxay isticmaalaa fiilka 'estar' + midab, oo ardayada ayay u tarjumaaan si adag ah 'I am agree'. Ingiriishi, 'agree' waa fiil, sidaas daraaddeed ma uu baahan yahay fiilka 'to be'. Inaad ka saartid, xusuuso in 'agree' waa shuqul, aan ahayn xaalad. Wax ka shaqaya si adag ah jumo 'I agree' ama 'I don't agree'.

levels.label: Basic Agreement and Disagreement
levels.translation: Bilowga iyo aan bilowayn asasiga ah

examples.note: Qalab simple in la soo baxshado bilowga. Waxaa la isticmaalaa xaaladooyinka adag iyo aan adagayn.
Qalab toos in la soo baxshado aan bilowayn. Isticmaal si fiican inaad noqonaysid cadow.
Cadaab in la soo baxshado wax ku xaqiiqsanaanta ah.
Qalab jaban in la soo baxshado aan bilowayn.

levels.label: Agreeing with Positive and Negative Statements
levels.translation: Bilowga xaaladooyinka xaqiiqsanaanta ah iyo aan xaqiiqsanaayn

examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la bilowga xaalad oo xaqiiqsanaanta ah. Misaal: I like coffee. So do I.
Badal adag oo ka mid ah iyo aan adagayn xaaladooyinka xaqiiqsanaanta ah.
Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la bilowga diida. Misaal: I don't like tea. Neither do I.
Tarta aan adagayn 'Neither do I'.

levels.label: Polite Disagreement and Expressing Doubt
levels.translation: Aan bilowayn adag iyo in la soo baxshado shaki

examples.note: Qalab adag in la soo baxshado aan bilowayn si aan toosayn.
Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la soo baxshado aan bilowayn jaban.
Ku soo baxsaa fiirka mid ka mid ah oo ka dib fiirkaaga aan bilowayn.

examples.translation: Runta in aan u maleynayo waa mid kal.
examples.note: Qalab adag in la soo baxshado aan bilowayn.

title: Describing Daily Routines / Sharciyooyinka maalinle ah u sheegay
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, adigoo leh 'aan u cadaadaa' ama 'u cadaadaa' adigaa isticmaalaya arrimaha each-reflexive. Af-Ingiriisi, ma isticmaalin arrimaha each-reflexive rutinka: keliya 'I get up'. Sidoo kale, Af-Soomaaliga badanaa ayay u dhaqaaqaan shaxsiga ('breakfast'), laakiin Af-Ingiriisi waa inaad isticmaashid 'I' ('I have breakfast'). Kala duwan wanaagsan oo kale: Af-Ingiriisi, si ay u sameeyaan shuqulka uu ku soo jeeda, ayay isticmaashid midhisha aad u sarreeya (present simple) ilaa -s ee shaxsiga saddexaad ('he gets up'), iyo erayada adagga adagga ('always', 'usually') ayay ku soo dhowaada ugu horreysa erayga, ma aha ugu dambeynta sidii Af-Soomaaliga ('siempre me levanto' vs. 'I always get up').
rule: Si ay u sheegaan sharciyooyinka maalinle ah Af-Ingiriisi, ayay isticmaashid midhisha aad u sarreeya (present simple). Xogta wuxuu ah: Shaxsiga + fiilka (ilaa -s si ay u soo jeedaan isaga/iyada/iyaga) + soo jeeda. Erayada adagga adagga (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) ayay ku soo dhowaada ugu horreysa fiilka ugu muhiimsan, laakiin ka dib fiilka 'to be'. Kalamadaha wakhtiga sida 'in the morning', 'at night' ayay ku soo dhowaada ugu horreysa ama ugu dambeynta jimicsiga. Xusuuso in Af-Ingiriisi ma ayay u dhaqaaqin shaxsiga. Tusaale ahaan: 'I wake up at seven.' / 'She always drinks coffee.' / 'They go to work by bus.'

concept_examples.text: I wake up at six every morning.
concept_examples.translation: Anigu u cadaadaa lix sookootii kasta subax.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk ʌp æt sɪks ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She usually takes a shower in the evening.
concept_examples.translation: Iyada ayay ku dambeeyaa duushooda galab.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈjuʒuəli teɪks ə ˈʃaʊər ɪn ðə ˈivnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: We have breakfast together at home.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaynu ku nabad galyahay guriga.

concept_examples.text: They always go to bed at eleven.
concept_examples.translation: Iyaga ayay ku dambeeyaa gudcurka sato.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz goʊ tu bɛd æt ɪˈlɛvən/

common_error.explanation: Khalaadaha caadiga ah waa inay u dhaqaaqaan -s shaxsiga mid. Af-Soomaaliga conjugationka ayay u badalaan ('u cadaadaa'), laakiin Af-Ingiriisi keliya ayay ku daraan -s ama -es. Khalaad kale waa inay u dhaqaaqaan shaxsiga ('Wakes up'), laakiin Af-Ingiriisi ayay u baahan yihiin. Si ay u oggolaadaan, xusuuso: he/she/it, ayay u daraan -s fiilka.

examples.note: Isticmaali 'get up' si ay u soo baxaan guri, ma aha 'wake up' oo ah u cadaadaysiga.
Af-Ingiriisi ayay isticmaashaan each-possessive 'his', ma aha each-reflexive 'se'.

examples.translation: Iyada ayay qaataan qaxanka la qalqalo.
examples.note: 'Have' ayay isticmaashaan cunto iyo cabbiro, ma aha 'drink'.

examples.original: They go to work by car.
examples.translation: Iyaga ayay u tashan shaqada gaari.
examples.note: Isticmaali 'by' + xogta nidaamka aan uu article (by car, by bus).

examples.translation: Anigu wax barashada Af-Ingiriisi ka dib.
examples.note: Each-adverb 'after' ayay ku soo dhowaada ugu dambeynta, sidii Af-Soomaaliga.

examples.translation: Iyada ayay arkay TV ka dib qoyska.
examples.note: He/she/it, fiilka 'watch' ayay u badalaan 'watches'

examples.original: I always eat lunch at noon.
examples.note: Each-adverb 'always' ayay ku soo dhowaada ugu horreysa fiilka 'eat', ma aha ugu dambeynta.

examples.original: He usually reads the news in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /hi ˈjuʒuəli ridz ðə nuz ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Wuxuu ku dambeeyaa akhbaruhu aqriyo subaxdii.
examples.note: Each-adverb 'usually' ayay ku soo dhowaada shaxsiga iyo fiilka.

examples.translation: Iyaga ayay uusan naftayada ugu horreysa habeenka.
examples.note: 'Never' ayay u jiraansho, ma ayay isticmaalin 'don't' jimicsiga oo kalena.

title: Talking about health and symptoms / Hadal ka baxay caafimaad iyo calaamooyin
bridge: Faransiiska waxay nu isticmaalaan fiili 'tener' si ay u soo baxaan calaamad: 'tengo dolor de cabeza', 'tengo fiebre'. Ingiriishi, waxaa la isticmaalaa 'have' ('I have a headache') calaamooyinka iyo 'feel' wax ka badan ('I feel sick'). Khalad weyn waxaa loo yiraahda 'I have cold' mar walba 'I have a cold', maxaa yeelay Ingiriishi calaamooyinka 'cold' ama 'headache' waxay ku dhacaan maqal 'a'. Had iyo jeer ogow in 'ache' waxaa loo isticmaalaa qaybo ka mid ah erayada la wada hadlay: 'headache', 'toothache', laakiin 'pain' dhiritaanka ku jira.
rule:
Si aad hadal ka baxdo caafimaad iyo calaamooyin Ingiriishi deggan A2, isticmaal qaybahaas:

1. **Have + calaamad:** Isticmaal 'have' (maa fiilka 'tener' ah) calaamooyin la soo baxay magacyo la tirto: 'I have a cold' (aan qabashado leh), 'I have a headache' (aan dhiritaan raas leh), 'I have a toothache' (aan dhiritaan fish leh). Xusuuso inaad isticmaashid maqalka 'a' ilaa magacyada la tirto.

2. **Feel + sifaad:** Si aad u soo baxdo wax ka badan, isticmaal 'feel' + sifaad: 'I feel tired' (aan u eg leh), 'I feel sick' (aan u naxariis leh), 'I feel dizzy' (aan u eg leh).

3. **Dhiritaan ku jira:** Haddii dhiritaanka ma aha mid la soo bandhigay, waxaad odhan kartaa 'I have pain in my back' (aan dhiritaan raas leh) ama 'my back hurts' (raasgu waa ii dhirin).

4. **Fiilka 'hurt':** 'Hurt' waxaa loo isticmaalaa in la yidhaahdo wixii ku dhex dhirto: 'My head hurts' (Raasku waa ii dhirin), 'My stomach hurts' (Dhibkagu waa ii dhirin).

5. **Ku dhawaad caafimaad:** Si aad u weydiiyo qof keliya sidee ayay u mahadsantahay: 'What's wrong?' (Maxaa ku dhacay?), 'Are you okay?' (Ma adoon tahay?), 'How do you feel?' (Sidee baad u mahadsantahay?).

6. **Talooyin:** Si aad u bixiso talooyin, isticmaal 'should' ama 'shouldn't': 'You should see a doctor' (Waa inaad u fiirsatad da’i), 'You shouldn't eat that' (Ma aha inaad cuntaa).

**Kharashood iyo hal qaab:**
- 'Cold' (qabashado) waa la tirto iyo maqal loo baahan yahay: 'a cold'.
- 'Flu' (qabashado) markaa ka badan maqal loo isticmaalo: 'I have the flu' ama 'I have flu', laakiin 'the flu' waa mid ka badan.
- 'Fever' (dhibaatada) maqal loo baahan yahay: 'I have a fever'.
- 'Sore throat' (dhiritaan raas) maqal loo baahan yahay: 'I have a sore throat'? Haa, maqal 'a' loo baahan yahay: 'I have a sore throat'.
- Calaamooyin ka badan maqal loo baahan yahay maxaa yeelay ay ma la tirtirin: 'I have a cough' (ama 'to cough'), 'I have a runny nose' (ama 'I have a runny nose'? halkan maqal 'a' loo baahan yahay).

**Tanu waa:** Ingiriishi, ma isticmaalin 'make' calaamooyin sida luqada Soomaaliga ('me duele' = 'it hurts' ama 'I have pain').

concept_examples.text: I have a headache.
concept_examples.translation: Aan dhiritaan raas leh.

concept_examples.text: I feel sick.
concept_examples.translation: Aan u naxariis leh.

concept_examples.text: My stomach hurts.
concept_examples.translation: Dhibkagu waa ii dhirin.

concept_examples.text: You should see a doctor.
concept_examples.translation: Waa inaad u fiirsatad da’i.

common_error.explanation: Luqada Soomaaliga waxay nu yidhaahdaan 'tengo frío' ama 'tengo un resfriado' maqal walba qaybo ka mid ah qaybaha, laakiin Ingiriishi 'cold' (qabashado) waa magac la tirto iyo maqal loo baahan yahay 'a'. 'Have got' waa mid ka badan iyo saxan. Si aad u tidhaahdo 'tengo frío' (xilli), waxaad odhan kartaa 'I am cold' ama 'I feel cold', ma aha 'I have cold'.

examples.note: Xusuuso in 'a cough' maqal loo baahan yahay. Luqada Soomaaliga waxay nu yidhaahdaan 'tengo tos' maqal walba.
Dhibaatada waxaa loo yidhaahda 'a fever' maqal loo baahan yahay, luqada Soomaaliga 'tengo fiebre' maqal walba.
'Sore throat' waa hadal la wada hadlay. 'Pain in the throat' ma aha mid la isticmaalo markaa ka badan.

levels.label: Expressing how you feel
levels.translation: U soo baxay sidee baad u mahadsantahay

examples.note: Isticmaal 'feel' + sifaad wax ka badan. Ha odhan 'I am having dizzy'.
'Tired' waa sifaad, ma aha fiil. Luqada Soomaaliga waxay nu yidhaahdaan 'estoy cansado', Ingiriishi 'I feel tired' ama 'I am tired'.
Jawaab ku jira markii la weydiiyo 'How are you?' ama 'How do you feel?'.

levels.label: Giving and asking about health advice

examples.note: Su’aalo ku jira si aad u ogaato wixii ku dhex dhirto qof keliya. Waa isku halleeyay.
Isticmaal 'should' + fiilka si aad u bixiso talooyin. Ha isticmaal 'should to rest'.
Fiilku waa 'take' dhabarrado, ma aha 'drink' ama 'eat'.

examples.translation: Ma aha inaad samatabbixin la qaato.
examples.note: 'Shouldn't' waa qaybta cadaadis 'should'. Waxaa loo isticmaalaa si loo talo galin inaan la qaado wixii la yidhaahdo.

translations.so: Hadal ka baxay caafimaad iyo calaamooyin

title: Making requests and offers / Cabbiriyeyaal iyo ka shaqeeya
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga ayannu amarkii ama 'Ma ayad u qaban tahay...?' u isticmaalo cabbiriyeyaasha, laakiin Af-Ingiriisiyani ayuu kuu dhexeeya 'Can' iyo 'Could' ka badan oo adag. Inuu ka shaqeyo, kuwa Soomaali ah ayay ku yidhaahdaan 'Ma ayad u doonaysaa inaan...?', laakiin Af-Ingiriisiyani ayuu kuu dhexeeya 'Can I...?' ama 'Do you want me to...?'. Xajis: Af-Ingiriisiyani, 'Could you...?' waa uun formal ka badan 'Can you...?', iyo ha u isticmaalina amarkii inaad cabbiriyeyaal u qorto, maxaa yeelay waa uun jira.
rule:
Cabbiriyeyaasha Af-Ingiriisiyani A2, ayannu u isticmaalo: 
- 'Can you + fiil...?' (qalad, kuu dhexeeya) 
- 'Could you + fiil...?' (uun formal ka badan oo adag) 
- 'Would you mind + gerund?' (uun formal ka badan, laakiin wax uun badaneeya). 
Inuu ka shaqeyo: 
- 'Can I + fiil...?' (Ma ayad u qaban tahay...?) 
- 'Do you want me to + fiil...?' (Ma ayad u doonaysaa inaan...?) 
- 'Would you like me to + fiil...?' (uun formal ka badan). 
Xasuuso in Af-Ingiriisiyani fiilka oo ka soo jeeda 'Can' ama 'Could' wuxuu kuu dhexeeya isku-dhexgashan 'to'. Inuu ka shaqeyo, isticmaal 'me to' oo ka soo jeeda 'want' ama 'like'. Ha isticmaalina 'Do you want that...' sidaa ayay Af-Soomaaliga tahay.

concept_examples.text: Can you help me with this?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaan kuu caawiyo waxan?

concept_examples.text: Could you open the window, please?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad furato fanoolka, fadlan?

concept_examples.text: Can I give you a hand?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaan kuu caawiyo?

concept_examples.text: Do you want me to get you a coffee?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad u doonaysaa inaan kuu keeno qaxanka?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə ɡet juː ə ˈkɒfi/

common_error.wrong: Do you want that I help you?
common_error.correct: Do you want me to help you?
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga ayannu leennahay 'Ma ayad u doonaysaa inaan kuu caawiyo?', iyo ardayada ayay u tarjumaadaan si adag oo leh 'that I'. Af-Ingiriisiyani, qalabka saxda ah ayaa 'want + shakhs + to + fiil', 'that + shakhs + fiil'. Kala duwan waa inaad isticmaashid 'Can I help you?' oo uun jira oo kuu dhexeeya.

examples.original: Can you pass me the salt?
examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad ii soo noqotay cunnta?
examples.note: Isticmaalka kuu dhexeeya hal qoto dhibaatooyinka. 'Pass me' wuxuu uun dhacaa 'ii soo noqotay', laakiin 'can' waa uun adag ka badan.

examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad fuushato billaabka?
examples.note: 'Can' ayaa lagu isticmaalo cabbiriyeyaal qalad ah ee dhexdhexaad ah ama shaqaalaha.

examples.original: Can you speak more slowly, please?
examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad hadashid u dhexeeyso, fadlan?
examples.note: Ku dar 'please' dhexdhexaadka inaad uun adag tahay.

examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad iigu soo xiriirto berri?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'could' inaad uun formal tahay ama markaad aanad uun aqoon shakhsiga.

examples.original: Could you bring us the menu, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː brɪŋ ʌs ðə ˈmenjuː pliːz/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad noo keenay menu-ga, fadlan?
examples.note: Guryaha cuntada, 'could' waa uun adag ka badan 'can'.

examples.original: Could you help me carry these bags?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː help miː ˈkæri ðiːz bæɡz/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaad i caawisay inaan qaado dhufanka?
examples.note: Inuu ka shaqeyo wixii thayan, isticmaal 'could' inaad uun adag tahay.

examples.original: Can I get you something to drink?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡet juː ˈsʌmθɪŋ tə drɪŋk/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u qaban tahay inaan kuu siiyo wax cabbin?
examples.note: Qalab kuu dhexeeya inuu ka shaqeyo wax, ku salaysan 'Ma ayad u doonaysaa wax cabbin?'.

examples.original: Do you want me to help you with that?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə help juː wɪð ðæt/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u doonaysaa inaan kuu caawiyo waxan?
examples.note: Qalab 'want + me + to' inuu ka shaqeyo caawimo oo kooban.

examples.original: Would you like me to open the window?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː laɪk miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaan lahaa inaan furo fanoolka?
examples.note: Uun formal ka badan 'do you want me to'. Wax uun badaneeya qalabka adeegga ama kuwa aanad uun aqoon.

title: Expressing Ability and Possibility / Qalad iyo suuragal
bridge: In Spanish, 'poder' is used for ability and 'saber' for knowing how to do something. In English, these two ideas are combined in the verb 'can' (present) and 'could' (past), but note: 'could' is not used for specific achievements in the past (for example, 'Could you swim?') and 'be able to' is used for tenses that 'can' does not have. Additionally, for possibility, 'can' and 'could' express general possibility, while 'may' and 'might' indicate more uncertain possibility, something that does not exist separately in Spanish.
rule: To talk about ability in the present, use 'can' + base verb (for example, 'I can swim'). In the past, for general ability, use 'could' + base verb (for example, 'I could swim when I was young'). For specific actions in the past (achievements), use 'was/were able to' (not 'could'). For possibility, 'can' indicates general possibility (for example, 'It can rain'), 'could' indicates past or conditional possibility (for example, 'It could rain later'), 'may' and 'might' indicate uncertain possibility (example 'She may come'). The negative form of 'can' is 'cannot' or 'can't', and for 'could' it is 'couldn't'. Do not use 'to' after 'can' or 'could'.

concept_examples.text: I can speak English and Spanish.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan ku hadalayaa Ingiriisi iyo Ispaanish.

concept_examples.text: Could you help me, please?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad iga caawisaa, fadlan?

concept_examples.text: She might be at home now.
concept_examples.translation: Waxay u baahan tahay inay guriga ku tiilto now.

concept_examples.text: We were able to find the hotel after asking.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan helay hotelka ilaa aan waydhnay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː wɜːr ˈeɪbəl tə faɪnd ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈæftər ˈæskɪŋ/

common_error.wrong: I can to play the guitar.
common_error.explanation: In Spanish, we say 'puedo tocar', sometimes with 'a', and there is a tendency to add 'to' after 'can'. But in English, 'can' is followed directly by the base verb, without 'to'. Remember: can + base verb, never can + to + verb.

examples.translation: Waxaan ku fiicnaa inaan u nacno.
examples.note: Use 'can' to express that you know how to do something. Note that in Spanish, 'saber' or 'poder' is used, but in English only 'can'.

examples.translation: Ma adig oo aad u fiicnaa inaad u qaadi doonto piano?
examples.note: In questions, invert the order: 'Can' + subject + verb.

examples.translation: Ma adig oo aad u fiicnaa inaad hadashu u hadashid.
examples.note: The negative form is 'can't' (contraction of 'cannot').

levels.label: Ability and Possibility in the Past

examples.original: When I was a child, I could run fast.
examples.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ wəz ə tʃaɪld, aɪ kʊd rʌn fæst/
examples.translation: Markii aan ahaa ilmo, waxaan u fiicnaa inaan u dhaqmo.
examples.note: Use 'could' for general ability in the past.

examples.original: I was able to finish the exam yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈeɪbəl tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ði ɪɡˈzæm ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.note: For a specific achievement in the past, do not use 'could', but 'was/were able to'.

examples.translation: Waxay u baahan tahay inay roobay habeenkii.
examples.note: In the past, 'could' also indicates possibility.
Use 'may' to ask or give formal permission.

examples.translation: Waxay u baahan tahay inay baxo berri.
examples.note: Use 'might' for uncertain possibility, especially in the future.
In informal English, 'can' is used for permissions.

title: Talking about weather / Hadalka ku saabsan caadiga
bridge: Faransiiska waxay nuugu leeyihiin 'wuu ku dhacay qalalan' ama 'ayuu roobay', oo ku isticmaala verbi 'hacer' ama 'estar'. Ingiriishi, caadiga wuxuu la soo hadlayay ilaa-ahayn 'it' sida dhibaato: 'It is hot', 'It is raining'. Cusuba tan waa mid muhiim ah maxaa yeelay Ingiriishi ayuu u baahan yahay dhibaato xog-ogaadan, halmarintii faransiiska ayuu u baahan yahay in la fogeeyo. Kala duwan kale waa in 'weather' Ingiriishi ayay u tahay mid aan la tirin karin, sidaas daraaddeed waxaynu odhan nayno 'a weather' ama 'weathers'.
rule:
Si ay u hadashid caadiga Ingiriishi A2, isticmaalo buunkaas:
1. 'It is' + mid dhaw: It is sunny, It is cloudy, It is windy, It is cold, It is warm.
2. 'It is' + fiil gerund: It is raining, It is snowing, It is hailing.
3. 'There is' + magac: There is a storm, There is fog, There is a rainbow.
4. 'There are' + magacyo ku dhowaad: There are clouds, There are showers.

Kala duwanaad iyo isticmaalka: 'It is hot' iyo 'It is cold' waxay u dhexeeya, laakiin waxaad isticmaalay kartaa 'It's warm' iyo 'It's cool'. In aad weyddii, isticmaalo 'What's the weather like?' ama 'How's the weather?' (maahee 'How is the weather?'). Xusuuso in 'weather' ayay u tahay mid aan la tirin karin: ha odhanina 'a weather'.

concept_examples.text: It is sunny today.
concept_examples.translation: Maanta wuu ku qalalan yahay.

concept_examples.text: It is raining outside.
concept_examples.translation: Ayuu roobay dibadda.

concept_examples.text: It is very cold in winter.
concept_examples.translation: Wuu ku qabowin yahay qabow weyn dhexdhexaad.

concept_examples.text: There are some clouds in the sky.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa jira qiiq u eg yara.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðər ər sʌm klaʊdz ɪn ðə skaɪ/

common_error.explanation: Faransiiska waxay nuugu leeyihiin 'el tiempo está caliente' ama 'hace calor', iyo ardayada ayay u jeedaan inay tarjimiyaan si adag. Laakiin Ingiriishi, inaad hadashid caadiga, waxaynu isticmaalaynaa 'it' sida dhibaato, maahaa 'the weather'. Inaad odhan 'the weather is hot' wuxuu u eg yahay mid aan la kulmin karin; saxiixdu wuxuu u tahay 'It is hot'. Si kastaba ha xusuuso in 'hot' ayay u tahay tirada xumadeda, maahaa caadiga oo dhan.

examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalay 'sunny' si loo soo hadlido maalintii uu qalalan yahay. Faransiiska waxaynu leynaynaa 'hace sol'.
'Cloudy' waxaa la isticmaalay marka ay jirto qiiq badan. Faransiiska waxaynu leynaynaa 'está nublado'.
'Windy' wuxuu u yahay inay jirto waday. Ha la wadaagin 'wind' (magac).
Xumade qabow. 'Cold' waxay u tariifay kartaa mid ama wax.
Waxaa la isticmaalay 'be + -ing' si loo hadlido shuqul ku socda. Faransiiska waxaynu leynaynaa 'está lloviendo'.
Baaru ma baxay qabow qabow. 'Snow' waa magaca, 'snowing' waa fiilka.
'Hail' waa magaca baxashada. Waxay u yar tahay, laakiin waxay u fidisan tahay.
Hadalka wuxuu u yahay in qiiqdu way ka baxaan oo qorraxdu way soo baxdo.

examples.translation: Sidee bay noqon doontaa caadiga berri?
examples.note: Su'aalan u dhexeeya ee ku saabsan dushooda. Isticmaalo 'like' dhammaadka.

examples.original: It will be rainy on Friday.
examples.note: Isticmaalo 'will' si loo hadlido dushooda. 'Rainy' waa mid dhaw, 'raining' waa shuqulka.

examples.original: It is going to snow tonight.
examples.note: 'Going to' waxaa u dhexeeya si loo hadlido talooyin la xiriiray (qiiq, iyadoo la mid ah).

examples.original: There will be a storm tomorrow.
examples.note: Isticmaalo 'there will be' si loo hadlido wuxuu noqon doonaa wax.
